High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Gaurav Kumar Verma - Advocate for the appellant.

Shri Kamal Kumar Tiwari- Government Advo
 respondent/State.

This application under Section 389 (1) of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 is filed seeking following relief;-
'' It is, this therefore, most respectfully prayed that the Hon'ble court may kindly be pleased to suspend the sentence of the appellant till disposal of the appeal.''
2. The applicant/appellant has been convicted for the offence punishable under Sections 376 (2) (n),
376 (3) and 506 (Part 2) of the IPC and sentenced to undergo 10 years R.I., 20 years R.I. and 2 years R.I. with fine of Rs. 1000/-, Rs. 3000/- and Rs.1000/- respectively with defaul stipulations as mentioned in the impugned judgment.
3.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of respondent/State has opposed the present application by submitting that there is a serious allegation against the applicant/appellant.
Therefore, the application deserves to be dismissed.

4. It is not in dispute that the prosecutrix (PW-1) admitted in her cross examination which is evident from para 12 that there was a previous enmity between applicant/appellant and her father due to which an FIR was 2 CRA-10137-2023 registered against the applicant/appellant.
It is also not in dispute that the applicant/appellant was on bail during the trial.
It is also submitted that the prosecution had not conducted the ossificaiton test.

5. In view of the above, we are of the opinion that it is a fit case to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the applicant/appellant and keeping in view the fact that present appeal is of 2023 and also that there are old appeals pending before us and the listing of the present appeal is not likely in near future
, we hereby suspend the jail sentence of the appellant during the pendency of the appeal.

Consequently, the appellant be released on bail, if not required in any other case, on he furnishing a bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court concerned with a further direction to appear before the trial Nitesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55636437/
1 Court, firstly on 20.12.2024 and also on such other dates as may be fixed by the trial Court in this regard during pendency of this appeal.
